name: N501 Verse
author: n501
description: Synchronized lyrics that stay with your music.

barWidget.description: Shows synchronized lyrics for the active media player.

schema.label: Bar size
schema.description: Compact uses 320 px, Standard 520 px, Expanded 720 px for the bar lyric slot.

schema.label: Network
schema.description: Auto performs provider lookups. Offline permits local files and existing shared-cache hits but performs no provider request.

schema.label: Netease
schema.description: Netease community source (experimental; word timing depends on availability, with no guarantee of availability, rights, or timing).

schema.label: LRCLIB
schema.description: LRCLIB free community source (ordinary results are line-timed, with no guarantee of availability, rights, or timing).

schema.label: Kugou
schema.description: Kugou community source (experimental; word timing depends on availability, with no guarantee of availability, rights, or timing).

schema.label: Translations
schema.description: Show translated lyric lines when the provider supplies them.

schema.label: Motion
schema.description: Animate the loading trace; lyric timing remains visible when off.
